_source.title: 检查文件系统内的文件或目录是否存在
_source.remarks.text.0: 注意 1：本接口仅客户端有效，在浏览器环境内调用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.remarks.text.1: 注意 2：本接口需要使用者启用扩展的外部交互权限，如若未启用将始终 `throw Error`
_source.params.uri: 文件资源定位符，需要包含完整的文件名称的绝对路径

title: Check whether a file or directory exists in the file system
remarks.text.0: Note 1: This API is only valid for clients. Calling it in a browser environment will always `throw Error`
remarks.text.1: Note 2: This API requires the user to enable the extension external interaction permission, if not enabled, it will always `throw Error`
params.uri: File resource locator. An absolute path containing the complete file name is required
returns: Whether the file or directory exists
